content: Abrahaame Paaceteth
Hessafe guye Xoossi Abrahaame paaccides; Xoossi, «Abrahaamee!» gi xeygiin Abrahaamey, «Yee!» gi koyides.
Xoossi, «Neni siiqiza ne mexi issi naaza Yisaaqa ekkada Mooriya geetettiza biitta ba; baada heen tani nees bessiza issi zuma bollan iza xuugettiza yarsho ooththada taas yarsha» gides.

Wonteththa gallas Abrahaamey maalado wonttara dendidi hare caanides; ba aylletappe nam7atanne ba naa Yisaaqa banara ekkidi xuuggiza yarshos gidiza mith qeri ekkidi Xoossi izas yootidaso baanaas dendides.
Bishe heedzdzanththa gallas Abrahaamey dhoqqu giidi yarsho yarshanasoza haahon be7ides.
Abrahaamey ba aylleta, «Intte harezara hayssan diishshite; taninne ta naazi gede biidi Xoossas goynnidi intteko haa simmana» gides.
Abrahaamey yarsho miththaa denththidi naaza Yisaaqa toossidi baas tamanne shuka mashsha oykkides; istti nam7ay issife bishin,
Yisaaqi ba aawa Abrahaame, «Aabboo!» gides. Abrahaameykka, «Yee! Ta naazoo!» giin Yisaaqi, «Tamaynne miththi dees shin yarshettana dorsay awanee?» gides.
Abrahaameykka, «Ta naazoo! Yarshettana dorsaa Xoossi giigsana» gides; histtiin istti nam7ay issife bida.
Istti Xoossi izas yootidaso gakkida wode Abrahaamey yarsho yarshizaso heen giigsidi miththaa korides; ba naa Yisaaqa qachchidi he miththaa bollan shukkanaas ishisides.
Abrahaamey ba naaza shukkanaas kushe yeddidi mashsha ekkides.
Gido attiin GODAA kiitanchchay saloppe iza, «Abrahaamee! Abrahaamee!» gi xeygiin izi, «Yee!» gi koyiin,
«Naaza bolla ne kushe woththofa; iza aykkoka ooththofa; neni ne mexi issi naazakka tana diggontta gishshas neni Xoossas yayyiza as gididayssa tani ha7i eradis» gides.
Abrahaamey dhoqqu giidi xeellishin kacey turan oykettida dharsho be7ides; Abrahaamey biidi he dharshoza ekkidi xuugettiza yarsho yarshides.
Hessa gishshas Abrahaamey he sohoza, «GODAY immizaso» gi sunththides; hach gakkanaaska he sohozi, «GODAY zuma bollan immana» geetettees.
GODAA kiitanchchay saloppe nam7anththo Abrahaame xeygidi,
«Tani nees tanan caaqqays; neni hayssa ooththida gishshas ne mexi issi naazakka tana diggontta gishshas,
tani nena tumu anjjana; ne zereththaaka tani salo xoolintte malanne abba doonan diza ace mala ooththada darsana; ne zereththati ba morkketa katamata laattana.
Neni taas azazettida gishshas ha kawoteththay wuri ne zereththa baggara anjjettana» gides.
Hessafe guye Abrahaamey ba aylletakko simmiin istti wuri issife Bersaabehe dendi bida. Abrahaamey Bersaabehen de7ides.
Naakoore Yeleta
Hessafe simmiin Abrahaames, «Milkay ne isha Naakoores nayta yeladus.
Isttika, bayra naa Uuxe, Uuxe ishata Buuze,
Aaraame aawa Qamu7eele, Keesade, Haazo, Pildaase, Yidilaafe, Baatu7eele geetetteettes.
Heyta he osppun naytakka Milka Abrahaame isha Naakoores yeladus; Baatu7eeli Irbiqa yelides.
Erehimo geetettiza iza garadeya qasse Xebaahe, Gehaame, Tehaashanne Makisa yeladus» gi yootida.

footnotes.text: GODAY immizaso gizayssi Ibraaweta qaalara Yahiwe yir7a gidishin birsheththay, «GODAY beyees» guussa
